[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Mary Glasgow was recorded as born on 27 November 1751 and baptized on 29 November 1751 at Irvine, Ayrshire, Scotland. The indexed parents are Michael Glasgow and Mary Crawfurd.<ref name="Irvine1751">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', transcript for Mary Glasgow, birth 27 November 1751, baptism 29 November 1751, Irvine, Ayrshire; parents Michael Glasgow and Mary Crawfurd; OPR 595/1, item 1, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3575849 transcript]. Derivative transcript inspected 23 October 2026; original register image not inspected.</ref> The currently linked father is [[Glasgow-1410|Michael Glasgow]] and the currently linked mother is [[Crauford-31|Mary Crauford]]. The transcript names the recorded parents but does not independently prove that either is the adult represented by those profiles, or identify Michael's earlier childhood.
